our-story.title: About Evoque Professional
body: Founded in 1980, Evoque Professional began its journey as a factory dedicated to producing high-quality hair sprays. We are proud to be Turkey’s first manufacturer of hair spray and perfume, and over the decades, our products have reached more than 100 countries worldwide.

In the early 2000s, we expanded into hair care products, driven by one simple belief: healthy hair starts with healthy ingredients. Every formula we create is inspired by nature and perfected through science, using only the finest ingredients sourced from trusted European companies.

By 2015, we opened our first branch in the United States, marking an important milestone in our global growth. Today, Evoque Professional offers solutions for all hair types and concerns, from damage repair and hair loss treatments to moisture balance and growth support.
Evoque Lebanon is the official home of Evoque Professional in Lebanon, bringing the full salon range to stylists, salons and customers across the country.
At Evoque, we don’t just create hair care, we create confidence. Because every strand deserves to shine with strength, health, and beauty.

about-evoque.title: About Evoque
body: With over 30 years of experience in the cosmetics industry, Evoque has established itself as a trusted, forward-thinking professional beauty brand. As an independent manufacturer, Evoque produces its own formulas and supplies private label solutions to brands worldwide.
We are committed to honest practices. Our hair care formulas are paraben-free and cruelty-free, and every product page lists its full ingredient list so you can see exactly what is inside.

We believe in setting the standard, not following it. Through innovation, transparency, and a deep respect for both people and the planet, we deliver high-performance cosmetics that our partners and customers can trust.

sections.heading: Our Vision
sections.text: We aim at creating a top quality brand adopting the principle of making a difference together with all our departments in the cosmetic industry, observing human and environmental health, and satisfying the requirements of the information age.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.text: We move ahead by increasing the knowledge level of our employees and industry, adopting honest working principles, considering our environment and people as members of our family, and being well aware that education and knowledge are the core elements of change. Our target is to create a top quality brand with affordable prices that can be adopted by everyone.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.text: We deliver across all of Lebanon. Orders placed before 2pm are usually delivered within 1–3 business days. Delivery is free on orders of $100 or more; a flat delivery fee applies below that. Cash on delivery is available.

sections.heading: Returns
sections.text: Our policy lasts 14 days. If 14 days have gone by since your delivery, unfortunately we can’t offer you a refund or exchange. To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused, sealed and in the same condition that you received it, in its original packaging.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.text: Once your return is received and inspected, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. If approved, your refund will be processed to your original method of payment, or as store credit for cash-on-delivery orders.

sections.heading: Damaged or wrong items
sections.text: If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us within 48 hours with a photo of the item and we will replace it at no cost.
